title: Finiteness of the cohomology of the extension by zero of a locally constant sheaf annihilated by a prime
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a Noetherian ring Lambda, an algebraically closed field k, a separated finite type scheme X of dimension at most one over k, an open immersion j : U -> X with U connected, a prime l, n > 0, and a finite type locally constant sheaf G of Lambda-modules on U_etale annihilated by l^n, the groups H^q(X, j_!G) are finite Lambda-modules when l is prime to char(k), and when X is proper (statement lines 16010-16024). The proof (proof lines 16026-16059) is a four-step reduction: a prime-to-l finite etale cover via the trace method, Zariski's main theorem, moving the shriek extension across the resulting finite morphism, and filtering the coefficient sheaf down to the constant case. H2: a composite reduction with four independent inputs, all written out.
